identity.title: Retain Metrics Acceptance Learn View Partial after concrete owner audit

origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that each remaining Partial be structurally reviewed rather than mechanically deleted or split.

state.current_summary: MetricsAcceptanceLearnView.xaml.cs의 concrete owner 감사가 완료되었다. View Partial은 required XAML/presentation adapter로 유지되고, MetricsAcceptanceLearnPresenter, Learn Window topic/refresh composition, and View-owned WPF sample-cell/brush/text/button/timer owners가 sample-gate state, presentation, lifetime, and test boundaries를 각각 소유한다. 독립 seam이 없어 production split은 만들지 않았으며, focused source/build/WPF/monitor and documentation evidence가 통과했다.

objective.summary: Audit MetricsAcceptanceLearnView's Partial structure and retain it only if existing concrete owners already provide sample-gate state, topic routing, timer lifetime, binding, and test boundaries without a new split.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not add a service, interface, manager, wrapper, forwarding Partial, or ViewModel split for file length alone.
Preserve Metrics Acceptance XAML names, automation IDs, fixed sample/gate stages, Play/Step/Reset behavior, cheat-sheet state, test facade, and Unloaded timer cleanup.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current/intended owners, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public/test contract, shortest reading order, and the reason no production split is justified.

The source contract proves that MetricsAcceptanceLearnView has no direct persistence/file-dialog/OpenCV/real-Recipe/tool-factory coupling and that the existing presenter, Learn Window composition, timer lifetime, XAML contract, and test owners are wired.

Focused Debug/Release contracts and builds plus Metrics Acceptance WPF smoke and dynamic monitor geometry pass; broader theme/DPI/input/native Tool/camera/SDK/GPU/actual Recipe runtime remains explicitly unverified.

artifacts.summary: Owner map, no-change structural decision, verification and unverified runtime boundaries.
Debug/Release source contracts, presenter contracts, WPF prechecks, screenshots, and monitor geometry.

evidence.observation: MetricsAcceptanceLearnView remains a required XAML/presentation adapter. MetricsAcceptanceLearnPresenter owns fixed samples, average/range/maximum statistics, average/outlier gate decisions, animation stages, formulas, status text, and numeric sample text; OpenVisionLearnWindow owns topic visibility, refresh, public/test facade, and child close lifetime; and the View owns only WPF cell/brush/text/button projection and timer attach/detach. The View and presenter have no direct persistence, file-dialog, OpenCV, real Recipe execution, Tool factory, or algorithm lifetime coupling, so no independent production seam was found.

MetricsAcceptanceLearnPartialBoundaryContract passed all 12/12 source checks in Debug and Release. The existing LearnMetricsAcceptanceContract passed 3/3 in both configurations. VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug completed with 0 errors and 2 existing MSB3270 architecture warnings; Release completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

RunUiPrecheck passed wpf_openvision_learn_metrics_acceptance_contract and wpf_openvision_learn_metrics_acceptance_view in Debug and Release with OK 2/2, layout/text/internal counts zero, and fresh 1040x700 and 760x700 PNGs. Broader theme/DPI/input, native Tool/file association, camera/SDK/GPU, actual Recipe execution/persistence and long-running runtime remain unverified; the documented legacy target wording mismatch was not weakened or deleted.

Dynamic Debug and Release monitor probes detected two monitors and selected the smaller-left \\.\DISPLAY2 with bounds X=-1920,Y=365,1920x1080. Each Metrics Acceptance smoke window was explicitly placed there; MoveSucceeded is true, IntersectingWindowCount is 1, IntersectsSelectedMonitor is true, and the focused smoke contract files contain only PASS lines.

events.summary: MetricsAcceptanceLearnView Partial은 required XAML/presentation adapter이며, MetricsAcceptanceLearnPresenter, Learn Window topic/refresh composition, and View-owned WPF sample-cell/brush/text/button/timer owners가 독립 책임과 lifetime을 이미 제공한다. 새 seam 없이 분리하면 forwarding wrapper나 WPF control leakage가 되므로 no-change로 유지한다.

PL-0053의 세 completion criteria가 current source, contract, build, WPF smoke, monitor, and documentation evidence로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. 전체 theme/DPI/input, native Tool/file association, camera/SDK/GPU, actual Recipe execution/persistence 및 long-running native runtime은 이 slice의 검증 범위가 아니다.

The Metrics Acceptance Learn View Partial retained-owner audit found no independent boundary that justified a production split; focused source/build/WPF/monitor/documentation evidence was recorded. Do not reopen without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency/lifetime boundary.
